exposure: duration of the passive phase of the second stage
duration of passive phase of second stage of labor
cohort: Women with second-stage cesarean deliveries of live-born singleton fetuses in cephalic presentation at term (n=747)
finding: The risk of a hysterotomy extension does not appear to be associated with second-stage obstetric characteristics, including the duration of the passive phase of this stage.
mod_finding: Factors significantly associated with hysterotomy extension were the surgeon's experience and forceps use during the cesarean.
